_comment: Canonical model registry. Every production-grade model used by the YorHA legal stack is declared here. rg-searchable — do NOT add to .gitignore. Binary GGUF/ONNX blobs are stored outside git (see pathEnv). Update this file when adding or removing models.

canonicalDimensions._note: Project canonical is 384-dim (embeddinggemma). Legacy 768-dim inputs exist only in migration paths. latent64 is derived routing only, never canonical ANN.

models.description: Gemma 4 E4B with GRPO legal LoRA merged. Serves text + vision (unified model). Primary generation lane.
models.notes: Stored as Ollama blob at %USERPROFILE%\.ollama\blobs\sha256-a79de882... Set TURBO_MODEL_PATH to the blob path or a converted GGUF. 5.3 GB on disk. Requires TURBO_NGL=99 on RTX 3060 Ti.

models.description: Multimodal projector sidecar for Gemma 4. Loaded alongside the primary model for vision input.
models.notes: Place at models/mmproj-F16.gguf to use the repo-local fallback. If absent, launch-turboquant.ps1 skips --mmproj (text-only mode). BF16 precision. Vision tower frozen during GRPO legal training — compatible with legal fine-tune.

models.description: Primary embedding model. 384-dimensional dense vectors — project canonical dimension. Used for content_384, summary_384, signature_384 vectors in codebase_chunks_384_hybrid.
models.notes: Ollama pulls this at embeddinggemma:latest. Native output is 768-dim; project truncates/projects to 384 as canonical. Do NOT use 768-dim vectors in codebase_chunks_384_hybrid. Legacy codebase_chunks_768 collection is migration provenance only.

models.description: Tiny client-side generation model. Runs in-browser via ONNX Runtime (WebGPU → WASM SIMD → CPU).
models.notes: 418 MB static bundle. Served from /gemma3_270m_onnx/ at runtime. Too large for git — must be copied from models/gemma3_270m/ after cloning. Not in .gitignore so rg can find it.

models.description: Client-side embedding model for browser-local retrieval fallback. Raw output is 768-dim; client-embed.ts projects to 384 to match server canonical.
models.notes: Served from /embeddinggemma_300m_onnx/. client-embed.ts mean-pools + L2-norms then projects to 384-dim to match server vectors. Not gitignored — rg-searchable.

models.description: Canonical merged Gemma 4 legal GGUF in vendor/models/. Used when TURBO_MODEL_PATH points here.
models.notes: gitignored binary blob in vendor/models/. Set TURBO_MODEL_PATH to this absolute path in .env.
gitignored binary in vendor/models/. Set TURBO_MMPROJ_PATH to this path in .env.

models.description: LoRA-merged Gemma 4 E2B in IQ4_XS quant. Legal fine-tune baked in — no runtime LoRA injection needed. Canonical production GGUF, verified loaded on :8090. 7.5B params, 4.7 GB on disk.

drafting._note: Mode C (75MB assistant MTP head) is preferred. Mode B (3.1GB full E2B GGUF) is fallback when Mode C binary support is unavailable.

models.notes: ROTORQUANT_MODEL_PATH and TURBO_MODEL_PATH both point to models/gemma4-legal-iq4xs-direct.gguf in .env. Runs on stock llama.cpp. DO NOT replace with the base E2B RotorQuant (no legal merge) or the round-trip LoRA-injection variant.

models.displayName: Gemma 4 E4B RotorQuant IQ4_XS (base, no legal)
models.description: Base weight-quantized Gemma 4 E4B without legal fine-tune. Use LEGAL_LORA_PATH to inject legal LoRA at runtime.
models.notes: Non-merged base model. 21.6 tok/s, 1762ms TTFT on RTX 3060 Ti — use gemma4-rotorquant:latest-iq4xs-direct instead for production. Only keep if round-trip LoRA injection testing is needed.

models.displayName: Gemma 4 E2B RotorQuant IQ4_XS (base, draft lane)
models.description: Speculative draft / assistant lane for MTP-assisted decoding. Base model — no legal LoRA merged. Pair with the :8090 synthesis lane when ENABLE_MTP_DRAFTER is enabled.
models.notes: 3.1 GB. Draft-only companion — no legal fine-tune. Use ENABLE_MTP_DRAFTER=1 with a compatible llama-server binary. This is NOT the canonical synthesis model; do not replace gemma4-legal-iq4xs-direct with this.

models.displayName: Gemma 4 E4B MTP Assistant Q4_K_M (75MB drafter)
models.description: Official Google MTP assistant head for Gemma 4 E4B. Lightweight speculative drafter — 75 MB Q4_K_M. Mode C speculative decoding: tiny dedicated drafter paired with gemma4-legal-iq4xs-direct on :8090. Converted from google/gemma-4-E4B-it-assistant safetensors.
models.notes: 75 MB on disk. Pair with --draft-model flag on a TurboQuant-capable llama-server binary. Use ENABLE_MTP_DRAFTER=1 + MTP_DRAFT_MODEL=<artifact path>. The 164 MB F16 sibling in .tmp/google-gemma4-e4b-assistant/ is available for higher-quality drafting at ~2× size cost. NOT a standalone chat model — assistant/MTP architecture only.

retrieval._legacyNote: codebase_chunks_768 is migration provenance only. All new retrieval uses codebase_chunks_384_hybrid.

latent.name: latent64
latent.purpose: coarse routing only — not canonical ANN

graphExpansion._note: Graph expansion runs AFTER initial fused semantic retrieval, seeded from top-5 results. Not an unseeded PageRank query.

cuvs._note: cuVS is a benchmark/acceleration lane. Do not promote to canonical serving without recall and latency gates vs Qdrant.

autoencoder._migrationNote: Existing autoencoder was trained on 768-dim inputs. Rebuild against 384-dim canonical embeddings, or document as legacy routing artifact only.

envVarPolicy.TURBO_MODEL_PATH: Absolute path to primary Gemma 4 GGUF. Required for llama-server launch. Points to models/gemma4-rotorquant:latest-iq4xs-direct.gguf in canonical setup.
envVarPolicy.ROTORQUANT_MODEL_PATH: Alias for TURBO_MODEL_PATH — read first by vlm-lifecycle.ts fallback chain. Same value in canonical setup.
envVarPolicy.TURBOQUANT_MODEL_PATH: Alias for TURBO_MODEL_PATH — read first by inference-router.ts fallback chain.
envVarPolicy.TURBOQUANT_MMPROJ_PATH: Absolute path to mmproj-F16.gguf. Read first by vlm-lifecycle.ts. Falls back to MMPROJ_PATH.
envVarPolicy.MMPROJ_PATH: Fallback mmproj path. Set in .env — used when TURBOQUANT_MMPROJ_PATH is not set.
envVarPolicy.TURBOQUANT_EXE_PATH: Path to llama-server.exe. Read first by inference-router.ts. Falls back to LLAMA_SERVER_PATH.
envVarPolicy.LLAMA_SERVER_PATH: Fallback path to llama-server.exe. Set in .env — used when TURBOQUANT_EXE_PATH is not set.
envVarPolicy.MTP_DRAFT_MODEL: Absolute path to the speculative draft / assistant model GGUF used by the MTP wrapper at 8090. Companion lane only; do not treat as the canonical synthesis model.
envVarPolicy.TURBO_PROFILE: KV cache profile: stock | turboquant | turboquant-safe | atomicbot (default: stock).
envVarPolicy.TURBO_KV_K: Override KV key cache type (e.g. q8_0, turbo3).
envVarPolicy.TURBO_KV_V: Override KV value cache type (e.g. q8_0, turbo3).
envVarPolicy.TURBO_NGL: GPU offload layers (default: 99 for full-GPU on RTX 3060 Ti).
envVarPolicy.DRAFT_MODEL_PATH: Optional speculative decoding draft model path. Set to empty string to disable in VLM mode.
envVarPolicy.LEGAL_LORA_PATH: Optional LoRA adapter GGUF for runtime injection into base-model GGUFs. Not needed for gemma4-rotorquant:latest-iq4xs-direct (LoRA already merged).
